message: pdm.lock does not match pyproject.toml: its content_hash is not the one PDM computes from the dependencies, sources and [tool.pdm.resolution] settings of pyproject.toml now, so pdm lock --check and pdm install --check fail until pdm lock runs again
fix: Run pdm lock and commit pdm.lock, or undo the change to pyproject.toml if it was not intended
